title: Generated contacts are in the sending queue
detail: The CSV has 10,250 deterministic invented businesses and 7,703 unique email addresses. 1,090 campaign recipients exactly match its emails. Names, domains, cities and platforms are generated, not researched. A guessed Gmail address may belong to an unrelated person.
fix: Preserve originals. Create an isolated working copy; quarantine exact generated matches and block sending until source evidence and recipient identity are established.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Categorization script overwrites the live lead database
detail: This script creates 10,250 artificial records and replaces leads_db.json, despite its categorization name. It does not categorize existing businesses.
fix: Move fixture generation to a separate test-only output in a copy. Production lead lists must never be its destination.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Dashboard and sender disagree about what exists
detail: leads_db.json contains zero businesses; campaign_db.json contains 2,051 pending recipients. The leads UI/stats read the empty file, but the sender processes the existing campaign queue. An empty dashboard is not an empty send queue.
fix: Reconcile copies with immutable lead IDs and campaign membership. Show pending recipients even when their source record is missing; block orphaned records.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Scraped leads are disconnected and have incomplete enrichment
detail: halal_leads_db.json contains 2,991 businesses, 1,046 with email data, 620 scan errors, and 556 without websites. All lack qualityTier. The standard dashboard/sender use leads_db.json instead. 935 queued emails match this scraped list; another 26 queue emails match neither it nor the generated CSV.
fix: Import a normalized copy with provenance, deduplication, review status and error retry history. Do not treat scraped email presence as mailbox verification.
disposition: software repaired; real-world evidence or live pilot still required

title: Import schema is incompatible with sender
detail: Import stores email but no emails array; sender sync only selects b.emails. Imported rows are labeled verified without a verification call. Deduplication by email key misses existing domain-keyed rows.
fix: Use one lead schema and one identity index. Store discovered/unverified on import, verify separately, and integration-test import-to-queue.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Failed email scans never retry
detail: getNeedingEmailScan excludes every previously attempted row, including timeout/error. The README promises transient-error retries. The separate scraped dataset already contains 620 errors.
fix: Add retryable states, attempts, nextRetryAt, capped backoff, and a manual retry action. Use a copy for recovery.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Deduplication can merge unrelated businesses
detail: Feed deduplication matches names alone, while storage keys by website hostname. Same-name stores and different businesses hosted on shared platforms can disappear; multi-location records are collapsed without an explicit policy.
fix: Use Maps place ID plus normalized business/location identity and separate website/contact entities.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Admin APIs have no authentication boundary
detail: No login, middleware/proxy authorization, or session checks exist in the inspected dashboard source. Reachable APIs can expose leads/inbox, edit templates/settings, control workers, and send inbox replies. Actual internet exposure was not tested.
fix: Require authenticated sessions on administrative pages/APIs, authorize mutations, validate origins, and keep only signed tracking/unsubscribe routes public.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Settings responses expose sensitive account fields
detail: GET removes only pass/password, leaving totpSecret, adminPassword and adminSecret fields. These fields exist in all configured account shapes. PATCH returns merged settings including mailbox credentials. Isolated tests reproduced both leaks without using real secrets.
fix: Return an explicit safe settings DTO. Never serialize secrets or ciphertext to the browser; add response tests for every credential field.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Credential settings are tracked by Git
detail: git ls-files lists settings.json despite .gitignore excluding it. Ignoring an already tracked file does not remove it from history. Whether the repository or its history was shared was not established.
fix: Review exposure and rotate affected secrets if exposed. Remove credentials from tracking through a separately reviewed change, retain a sanitized example, and scan history without printing secrets.
disposition: API/store protections implemented; credential rotation and repository history cleanup remain owner actions

title: Website audits can request private network resources
detail: The audit endpoint accepts a caller-controlled URL and fetches it with default redirects. No private/loopback/link-local address checks or redirect revalidation are present.
fix: Permit only HTTP(S), validate resolved addresses and every redirect, block private ranges, cap response sizes and concurrency, and test DNS rebinding cases.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Tracking links are forgeable redirects
detail: Base64 email and destination parameters are unsigned. Anyone can increment a known lead's clicks or redirect through your domain to any HTTP(S) destination. A protocol check does not prevent an open redirect.
fix: Use signed opaque message/link IDs, allow only recorded destinations, and separate bot events from human engagement.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Unsubscribe signing has a known fallback secret
detail: Sender and endpoint fall back to a public hardcoded secret when ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing. GET also immediately suppresses recipients, including when a link scanner visits. Tokens expire after 90 days.
fix: Fail closed on absent signing keys, separate key purposes, use a confirmation GET and signed one-click POST, and define a durable opt-out link policy.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Development startup can start two live senders
detail: Root dev starts dashboard dev plus start.js; dashboard dev itself starts start.js. Each scheduler immediately invokes startCampaign. In-process flags do not coordinate two processes. The current campaign is paused, which currently prevents dispatch.
fix: Separate UI and workers. Start workers explicitly; use one durable worker lease, a test transport in development, and paused-by-default campaigns.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Missing or corrupt campaign state means running
detail: Invalid JSON and missing state fall back to running; the API has the same default. An isolated corrupt-state test confirmed this.
fix: Default to paused/error and require explicit validated activation. A missing state file must never authorize sending.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Dry runs mutate real campaign state
detail: Dry runs mark recipients sent, assign message IDs, increment limits/A-B counters, and record successful account health. followup.js also advances stages and counts. Previewing can therefore skip real outreach and pollute reports.
fix: Make dry run side-effect free or use an explicit isolated database copy and mock SMTP. Assert originals remain byte-identical.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: File locks do not prevent lost updates or stale suppression
detail: Campaign/inbox singleton objects load once and later overwrite whole files. Locks cover only writes, not the read-modify-write lifecycle; several APIs do not lock at all. A running sender can miss an API unsubscribe and later overwrite it.
fix: Use transactional storage with fresh eligibility checks and conditional updates. Until migrated, one shared writer and locked reload/mutate/write are required.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: SMTP acceptance and durable send recording are not atomic
detail: SMTP sends before record persistence; campaign writes are batched and errors are swallowed. A crash or write failure can leave an accepted email pending and resend it on restart. There is no per-recipient/stage durable claim.
fix: Add an outbox, unique campaign/lead/step keys, send leases, durable attempts and explicit ambiguous-delivery recovery. Test crashes before/after SMTP acceptance.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Corrupt data can be replaced with empty databases
detail: Multiple API read helpers swallow parse errors then mutate default empty objects. db.js and campaignDb.js rename corrupt originals to .bak and may start fresh on other errors. Write failures log but do not fail callers.
fix: Preserve originals, stop mutations on read/schema errors, write unique versioned backups to copies, and test restore. Never repair by silently resetting data.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Follow-ups can continue after a reply
detail: Candidates are snapshotted before the loop. Unlike the initial sender, follow-up execution does not recheck current status before sending. A reply handled during its delays can leave the old candidate eligible.
fix: Re-read transactional recipient, reply and suppression state immediately before each send; cancel pending follow-up jobs on any inbound reply.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Business hours and limits are not reserved per message
detail: Follow-ups check business hours once for the entire batch. Initial sends and follow-ups have separate guards and can race on shared remaining capacity; warmup level*10 replaces rather than caps the configured daily limit.
fix: Check schedule per attempt and reserve account/global capacity transactionally across all send paths. Cap by the smallest applicable limit.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Round-robin can spin when no account is eligible
detail: If one healthy account is maxed and another unhealthy account is under limit, allMaxed is false and healthyAccounts is nonempty. Both branches continue forever without advancing queue or sleeping.
fix: Build a single eligible-account set that combines health, pause and capacity. Exit or schedule a retry when it is empty.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Sequence editor does not control the active sequence engine
detail: Scheduler uses sender.js/followup.js. followup.js reads delays by fixed step numbers but hardcodes four templates/stages. Reordering, deleting or adding steps in the UI does not produce the displayed behavior; sequenceRunner.js is a separate engine.
fix: Choose one sequence executor that reads the saved versioned definition. Test reordered/custom/disabled steps and preserve enrolled sequence versions.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: All send errors are recorded as recipient bounces
detail: Auth failures, connection outages and rate limits all mark recipients bounced in sender/followup despite the health engine classifying them separately. Valid prospects become terminal failures.
fix: Persist typed attempt errors, retry transient/provider failures with backoff, and suppress only confirmed permanent recipient failures.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Configured SMTP ports can disagree with TLS mode
detail: Sender, follow-up and inbox reply transports force secure:true even when SMTP port is 587. Diagnostics correctly use smtpPort===465, so a mailbox can pass diagnostics yet fail actual sends.
fix: Centralize transport configuration and support explicit implicit TLS/STARTTLS with validated port settings and bounded timeouts.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Inbox replies bypass shared delivery controls
detail: Manual reply path does not check suppression/account health, reserve quotas, record delivery attempts or increment common daily counters. It lacks In-Reply-To/References. Automation and conversation history diverge.
fix: Route manual replies through the same durable send service, define an explicit manual-send policy, and preserve original Message-ID threading.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Advertised domain suppression is not enforced by active sender
detail: A 90-day domain guard exists and health UI claims it is active, but sender.js/followup.js never call it. Applying it blindly would also suppress every address at shared providers such as gmail.com.
fix: Define organization-aware suppression and enforce it for new outreach centrally; exclude follow-ups within the same approved conversation and avoid public mailbox-domain grouping.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Quoted footer turns positive replies into opt-outs
detail: The entire parsed text is searched for unsubscribe before genuine-reply processing. A normal reply quoting your own footer triggers suppression. An isolated interested-reply fixture reproduced this.
fix: Strip quoted history/signatures, inspect the new reply text, and match the original lead identity. Test positive replies with quoted opt-out footers.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Late and continuing conversations are dropped
detail: Only sent/followed_up_1/followed_up_2 can enter the inbox. Replies after follow-up 3, breakup, or an earlier interested reply are not stored. Reading mail elsewhere also removes it from UNSEEN scanning; messages older than 14 days are skipped.
fix: Use durable per-mailbox UID/UIDVALIDITY checkpoints, store all correlated inbound messages idempotently, and separate capture from campaign transitions.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Bounce and auto-reply classification is unreliable
detail: Unknown system messages default to hard bounce; any known email in the DSN body may be marked bounced. Normal-address out-of-office messages can become interested replies. No structured DSN or Auto-Submitted interpretation is used.
fix: Parse DSN recipient/status fields and auto-response headers, preserve raw evidence, and send ambiguous messages to review.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Reply scan timeout does not cancel the work loop
detail: Racing a timeout returns partial results but scanWork can continue to later accounts. Cleanup can itself wait on logout. Scheduler and manual sync can overlap, operating from separate snapshots.
fix: Use cancellable bounded per-account tasks, a scan lease, durable checkpoints and explicit partial/failure status.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Unknown mailbox results are treated as valid
needle: SMTP timeout â€” accepted on MX basis
detail: Timeouts, blocked probes and temporary SMTP replies become valid:true and are sendable. RCPT acceptance is labeled confirmed without catch-all detection. DNS transient failures become invalid; the dashboard verifier uses a different MX-only rule.
fix: Use verified/invalid/risky/unknown with timestamps and reasons. Retry unknown; require an explicit policy before sending risky results. Share the same verification service.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Verification corrupts campaign outcomes
detail: Bulk verification converts failures, including DNS timeouts, to bounced even if no send occurred. Successful checks do not persist a corresponding verified status/result. Imported rows already claim verified without checks.
fix: Separate verification from outreach status and account bounce metrics. Persist result, evidence and expiry; never count a pre-send check as an SMTP bounce.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Correction: account routes existed under ignored paths
detail: The initial audit missed existing account routes because a broad accounts/ ignore rule hid them. The missing-route assertion was incorrect. Existing management routes still needed authentication, safe credential handling, validation and shared storage.
fix: Correct the ignore rule and repair the existing account page, CRUD/import and diagnostic routes.
disposition: original absence claim withdrawn; existing routes repaired

title: Health panel reports checks it never performed
detail: It claims active locks and 90-day suppression are verified without testing either, and defaults unknown account scores to 100. Existing files/configuration are treated as proof of operational health.
fix: Show unknown/not-tested/stale distinctly. Display real diagnostic timestamps, worker heartbeat and enforcement evidence.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Failed diagnostics do not reliably block sending
detail: Eligibility checks pause/errors/bounce rate but not lastSmtpStatus, lastImapStatus, missing DNS or diagnostic age. runAccountDiagnostics stores failures without necessarily tripping the breaker. Scores and send permission disagree.
fix: Make fresh verified SMTP/IMAP readiness and required DNS evidence part of centralized eligibility, with explicit recovery criteria.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: DNS checks overstate deliverability readiness
needle: All DNS records are correctly configured
detail: Checks only find SPF/DMARC strings and MX records; DKIM and alignment are not tested. SPF authorization for the configured provider is not evaluated. The success message is broader than the evidence.
fix: Check configured-provider authorization, DKIM selectors and actual received Authentication-Results. Label DNS presence separately from authentication and inbox placement.
disposition: software repaired; real-world evidence or live pilot still required

title: Account metrics omit stages and misstate recency
detail: totalSent excludes followed_up_3, breakup_sent and unsubscribed. lastActiveAt picks sentAt before later follow-up timestamps. These mutable-status metrics feed bounce rates and account health.
fix: Use immutable send/bounce/reply events with explicit denominators and rolling time windows; derive latest activity with max timestamps.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Template variants in editor and sender are incompatible
detail: Editor stores initial_B objects; sender reads initial.subjectB/textB. Current initial has textA/B/C but no text, so base editor body is empty. Saving a visible change can leave the actually sent variant unchanged. Both cases reproduced.
fix: Create one versioned template/variant schema and server rendering path shared by editor, preview and sender.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Sequence personalization loses contact names
detail: Sender synchronization drops firstName/contactName/email from template data. Existing templates use First Name, so known contacts fall back to 'there'. Generated customSentence is not referenced by the current templates.
fix: Preserve verified contact metadata; render the exact recipient/account/variant preview before enrollment. Avoid guessing personal names from generic addresses.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Blank templates and unresolved placeholders can be sent
detail: Missing/corrupt templates return defaults with an empty body. Unknown merge tags remain literal. API validation accepts empty objects and does not validate subjectA/textA variants or required sequence templates.
fix: Block launch on missing/blank templates, unresolved tags or invalid variants; validate every enrolled step against representative real data.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Outreach copy contains claims not substantiated by project evidence
detail: Follow-up copy says a site was inspected 'again this week' and suggests 15â€“25% extra sales without per-lead audit evidence. Portfolio helpers assert specific conversion gains and client volumes. These may be true, but this repository does not substantiate them.
fix: Require owner confirmation and evidence for every case study/result; replace unsupported copy with truthful, specific observations from a completed audit.
disposition: software repaired; real-world evidence or live pilot still required

title: Sender identity and footer are not reliably complete
detail: Settings contain a placeholder physical address. A per-account signature replaces the entire standard footer, so identity/opt-out text may disappear. Settings footerText is not used by automated sender/followup.
fix: Keep validated sender identity and opt-out footer mandatory and separate from the signature. Block placeholder addresses and preview the complete final payload.
disposition: software repaired; real-world evidence or live pilot still required

title: Pricing and proposal commitments need one source
detail: Cold email offers start at $150/$700/$1,200; proposal defaults are $1,500â€“$4,000 with fixed timelines and aggressive speed promises. Scope, revisions, client dependencies, payment milestones and acceptance criteria are absent.
fix: Create a consistent service catalog and discovery-based proposal scope. Label estimates and document exclusions, client inputs, revisions, milestones and handover.
disposition: software repaired; real-world evidence or live pilot still required

title: A/B attribution does not follow actual sends
detail: Sender records abVariant but stats reads variant, assigning missing values to A. Reply detector does not update A/B reply counters, while winner selection depends on those counters.
fix: Record immutable experiment/version/variant per message and attribute qualified replies to it; test A/B/C sends through reply and reporting.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Preflight is a forecast with hardcoded pass flags
detail: Template/DNS/suppression checks are constant true; suppressed count is zero; no usable mailbox still yields at least one. Forecast ignores the actual pending queue, saved sequence delays, global limits, business days and warmup.
fix: Build launch readiness from the same eligibility engine as sending. Separate assumptions from measured checks and simulate actual scheduled jobs.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Postmortem treats negative replies as positive and invents revenue defaults
detail: Any repliedAt increments positiveReplyCount, even rejected offers. A closed deal with missing/zero value becomes $2,500. Zero sends can get A+ and a recommendation to scale. Legacy campaignPostMortem.js fabricates meetings/deals/revenue outright.
fix: Report observed CRM/event facts, preserve unknown/zero values, distinguish sentiment and require sufficient data before conclusions.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Website audit scores are presented as stronger evidence than they are
detail: HTML substring checks cannot establish above-fold placement or checkout conversion. Timing measures response arrival rather than rendered page performance, and hasSsl derives from URL prefix. An error page can still be scored.
fix: Label heuristic checks; verify HTTP status/final URL, use browser performance/a11y evidence for measured claims, and store evidence with each finding.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Quality score and filter vocabulary conflict
detail: Audit writes High Priority/Medium Priority/Low Priority into qualityTier; the UI filters top/average/low. Missing scores are fabricated as 65, and zero becomes 65 via ||. QualityEngine uses yet another vocabulary.
fix: Use canonical enums and distinguish site quality, opportunity and contact confidence. Preserve unknown and zero explicitly.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Settings cannot be saved after normal load
detail: GET's accounts field is merged into local state; Save PATCHes the whole state, but the server forbids any accounts property. Isolated API roundtrip returns 403.
fix: Keep editable settings separate from account metadata, PATCH only allowlisted changed fields, and show the server's actionable error.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Inbox polling becomes a continuous fetch loop after selection
detail: fetchThreads depends on selectedThread and replaces it with a fresh response object; the effect depends on fetchThreads and invokes it immediately. A selected thread can trigger fetch/update/effect/fetch continuously.
fix: Depend on a stable selected ID; update data without resetting the polling effect. Verify request frequency after selecting a conversation.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Reply draft can follow you into a different recipient
detail: One replyText state is shared by all conversations, and selectThread does not clear/store/confirm the draft. Switching threads can send a message intended for one prospect to another.
fix: Key drafts by lead/thread ID and guard recipient changes and navigation while a draft is unsent.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: CSV import cannot roundtrip its own export
detail: Importer assumes email-first columns and splits on commas; exporter is business-name-first. The supplied CSV has yet another schema. Quoted commas/newlines break parsing and websites/contact names are not mapped.
fix: Use a real CSV parser, header mapping, typed validation, preview, error rows and import/export roundtrip tests.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Bulk selection and export target the wrong set
detail: Select-all-matching and export-filtered omit qualityTier, so they include contacts outside the visible quality filter. Export-selected only uses current-page leads, dropping selected records from other pages.
fix: Share one filter serializer and export/act on stable server-side IDs. Display exact eligible and excluded counts before bulk actions.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Sidebar and inbox have no mobile layout
detail: Sidebar is fixed at 256px with no responsive collapse; inbox adds a fixed 380px list. Root body hides overflow. On a narrow screen, the navigation alone consumes most width. Leads also show 15 fixed-width columns.
fix: Add accessible mobile navigation, stacked inbox/detail views, responsive form grids and configurable table columns; verify 360/390/768px widths and zoom.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Shared modal lacks accessible dialog behavior
detail: No dialog role/aria-modal/label connection, focus trap, initial/return focus or background inertness. Close icon has no accessible name. Overlay/Escape still close while loading.
fix: Use a tested dialog primitive or implement those behaviors; block unintended close while committing and support bounded scrolling.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Controls and notifications need accessibility repairs
detail: Toasts lack live-region announcements and close names. Leads sort headers are click-only; select checkboxes lack labels; logs search lacks a label. Navigation lacks aria-current and a skip link. Small muted text needs contrast measurement.
fix: Add names, semantic controls, keyboard support, aria-sort/current/live, focus indicators and adequate contrast. Run automated and keyboard/screen-reader checks.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Loading errors can look like healthy or empty data
detail: Layout defaults unknown status to running and swallows fetch errors. Leadgen/logs/sequence/inbox also swallow failures. Users cannot distinguish an empty inbox from a broken backend or a stale worker.
fix: Show loading/error/stale/unknown states with last successful refresh, retry actions and worker heartbeat. Never infer healthy/running from missing data.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Edits and filters are easy to lose
detail: Templates/settings/sequences have no dirty-navigation protection; filters/tabs are component state rather than shareable URL state. Lead fetches lack cancellation so older responses can overwrite newer searches.
fix: Persist URL state where useful, guard unsaved changes, debounce and abort obsolete requests, and test back/forward navigation.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Suppression removal has no confirmation or audit reason
detail: Removing an opt-out issues DELETE immediately. This is more consequential than an ordinary list delete, yet there is no reason, proof of re-consent or confirmation flow.
fix: Require an explicit reason and deliberate confirmation, preserve suppression history and show the effect on future eligibility.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Motion and tiny text reduce usability
detail: CSS contains a reduced-motion rule, but Framer Motion and smooth scrolling are not centrally tied to it. Several controls use 9â€“11px text; transition:all appears in shared styles.
fix: Use targeted transitions, a shared reduced-motion preference and readable control/helper text. Measure contrast rather than relying on the palette.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Existing test suite can delete original lead data
detail: Tier 3 deletes leads_db.json without restoration. Test helpers overwrite original databases/.env, and parallel files share those paths. This suite was deliberately not executed. Its existence may explain data loss but causation is unproven.
fix: Use isolated copies/temp roots for every test, block outbound network/SMTP, await fixture callbacks and verify original hashes. Never run this suite against original lead lists.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Tests and build checks do not establish readiness
detail: Several tests assert true or only search output/source text. Backend type checking currently fails with 14 diagnostics; frontend source lint has 3 errors and 12 warnings. Dashboard tsc passes. Production build and live browser tests were not completed.
fix: Replace placeholders with workflow assertions, expand checks to all active backend modules, fix reported errors, and run production build plus isolated end-to-end tests.
disposition: software repaired; real-world evidence or live pilot still required

title: Worker lifecycle and logs lack reliable monitoring
detail: No durable worker lease/heartbeat or unified graceful worker shutdown exists. Logs grow without rotation; API reads the full file then slices it. warn/debug events are not captured by the custom logger. Process launch status is not send-worker health.
fix: Add a managed worker, heartbeat, bounded structured/redacted logs, job outcomes, shutdown/drain and alert delivery with retries.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Scraper process ownership and forced stop risk lost work
detail: Start does check-then-spawn without an interprocess claim; simultaneous requests can launch duplicates. Windows stop uses forced tree kill, bypassing graceful save. PID checks only test existence and can mistake reused PIDs.
fix: Use a supervised job lease and process identity, graceful cancel with checkpoint acknowledgement, then bounded termination. Test on copies.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Project plan is too broad and partly stale
detail: The plan still calls the integration TBD and groups everything into three milestones. dashboard/task.md marks account setup complete although its routes are absent. README describes different timing defaults and a narrower scraper.
fix: Replace completion claims with evidence-based milestones, dependencies, acceptance tests and a launch checklist covering data, safety, account health, UI and operations.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Duplicate implementations cause behavioral drift
detail: Two sending approaches, two reply listeners, two verifiers, two scraper managers and duplicate analytics/portfolio logic disagree. config/index.js is described as authoritative but active modules hardcode different thresholds.
fix: Choose authoritative shared services and explicit entry points; retain originals/legacy files as needed but prevent accidental execution. Test UI/API/worker contracts.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use

title: Server inputs lack operational bounds
detail: Settings accept wrong types, negative limits, reversed hours/delays and arbitrary sequence structures. Leads pagination is not bounded; bulk verification accepts unbounded arrays and processes them sequentially. Import locks are not released in finally on malformed rows.
fix: Validate typed schemas and cross-field constraints, cap payloads/page sizes/batches, run long work as cancellable jobs, and always release locks in finally.
disposition: implemented; validate external operation before live use
